members.statement: A collision between two source points persists infinitesimally, and analytically under a small analytic deformation, when the two Jacobians remain invertible.

members.statement: The displayed one-parameter family G_lambda has constant determinant, a persistent collision, cubic generic degree, and generic S3 monodromy.
members.title: Technical claim

members.statement: Over the complex numbers, the omitted set of G_lambda is exactly the union of the Gamma and Lambda curves, including the p=0 chart.
members.title: Technical claim

members.statement: For generic lambda other than 0 and -324, the unique positive-genus omitted component and its birational/Albanese data distinguish stable equivalence classes.
members.title: Technical claim

members.statement: The lambda=0 member is stably distinct from the generic members by omitted-component count.
members.title: Technical claim

members.statement: At lambda=-324 the boundary polynomial factors, the Lambda locus has two G_m components, Gamma is P1 minus six points, and the omitted locus has three components; the map still has generic degree three and S3 monodromy.
